patterns.note: A dark mode aesthetic with full-width sections and centered content blocks, using generous vertical spacing between major sections.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are paired with lighter weight body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy. Uppercase text is used for labels and sub-headings to add emphasis.
A high-contrast palette features a very dark background, white text, and a vibrant teal/cyan gradient as the primary accent color for CTAs and interactive elements.
Content sections and individual elements animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as the user scrolls down the page.
A prominent 'Made with WAVS' section showcases artist profiles in a horizontally scrollable carousel, serving as strong social proof and community engagement.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark mode design with high contrast between text and background for readability. Full-bleed background video is used in the hero section to create an immersive visual experience. Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation library (like AOS), applying a staggered fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. The 'Made with WAVS' section uses a horizontal carousel component (like Swiper) to display multiple artist profiles in an interactive manner. The main navigation remains sticky at the top of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, modern sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with lighter weight body text, and smaller uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and cards, creating a soft but not overly rounded aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive dark mode aesthetic, combined with the vibrant teal and cyan gradient accents, creates a high-tech and creative industry feel. The prominent 'Made with WAVS' section, featuring a horizontally scrollable carousel of artist profiles, serves as a powerful social proof and community-building element that sets it apart from typical marketing sites.
